newsitem.title: UK: Warburg to place 5 mln A&L shrs - traders.
newsitem.headline: Warburg to place 5 mln A&L shrs - traders.

text.p: SBC Warburg placed some five million shares in Alliance & Leicester Plc at 618p, dealers said on Thursday.
They said there had been a large seller lurking in the market on Wednesday, but it apparently was unsuccessful in unloading the shares.
"They didn't succeed in getting rid of (the shares) yesterday," said one dealer. "But the seller was still out there. I'm surprised by how well the market is holding up."
At 1038 GMT, the shares were down 4p at 619-1/2 on volume of 9.1 million shares. --Debra Sherman, London Newsroom +44 171 542 5106
